undanaṭṭha: [Undana+attha] (pu) CL=7 The meaning of wetness or the meaning that is a state of wetness.
undriyanakāla: [Undriyana+kāla] (pu) CL=7 A period of falling and destroying.
undriyanasadda: [Undriyana+sadda] (pu) CL=7 The sound of falling and destroying. The sound of being broken apart.
undriyati: [U+dara+ya+te] (kamma,kri) CL=7 Falls and destroys. Breaks up. Undriyati(kamma,kri) [u+dara+ya+te] Falls and destroys.  See - Undriyati.
undriyi: [U+dara+ya+ā] (kamma,kri) CL=7 Collapsed or fell down. See - Undriyati.
undriyissati: [U+dara+ya+ssate] (kamma,kri) CL=7 It will fall apart. Indiyati - See.
undura: [Unda+ura] (pu) CL=7 [Vi,pi,dhāna. Unda kiledane, undati kiledatīti undaro=ākhu. Ṇvādi.148.] A rat.
undūra: [Unda(udi)+ūra] (pu) CL=7 [Vi,pi,dhāna. Undapasavanakledanesu ūro. Dhāna,ṭī,618. Paṃsuṃundati pasavatīti undūro. Kaccaññaḥ. 670, nīti, sutta. 1316.] A mouse.
undūravaccabhāva: [Undūravacca+bhāva] (pu) CL=7 As the state of the excrement of a rat.
unna: [Unda+ta.sūci] (ti) CL=7 [Unda kledane, inno, unno vā. Dhāna, ṭī. 753.] Moistened.
unnadanta: [U+nada+a=anta] (ti) CL=7 [In Thīunnadantī] (1) One who shouts loudly. (2) Making echo (sound).
unnadanti: [U+nada+a+anti] (kri) CL=7 They shout loudly. See - Unnadati-(1).
unnadantī: [U+nada+a+anta+ī] (thī) CL=7 Made the echo (sound). See - Unnadati-(2). Unnadantī(ti) [unnatadanta+ī] One who has a long eyetooth. Unnadantī(thī) [unnata+danta. Itthījotaka īpaccaya] (A female lion) with a long eyetooth.
unnadati: [U+nada+a+ti] (kri) CL=7 (1) Proclaims. Shouts loudly. (2) Sound loud. Making an echo sound.
unnadi: [U+nada+ī] (kri) CL=7 Shouted loudly. Made the echo sound.
unnaditvā: [U+nada+tvā] (kri,vi) CL=7 Having proclaimed. Having shouted loudly.
unnahanā: [U+naha+yu] (thī) CL=7 Tied in the past. Attached in the past. The words (sound) that are a cause of binding.
unnama: [U+namu+a] (pu) CL=7 (A) A high place; (B) A high land. (B) (Pride) that is a proud nature. One who is arrogant.
unnamanta: [U+namu+anta] (ti) CL=7 One who is proud. See also - Uṇṇamanta.
unnamanti: [U+namu+a+anti] (kri) CL=7 They rise up. See - Unnamati-(A).
unnamate: [U+namu+a+te] (kri) CL=7 He rises up. See - Unnamati-(B).
unnamati: [U+namu+a+ti] (kri) CL=7 (A) He is proud (of). (B) He rises up.
unnamehi: [U+namu+ṇe+hi] (kā,kri) CL=7 Causes to rise up. Causes to bend upwards. Causes to be straight. See - Unnameti.
unnamenta: [U+namu+ṇe+anta]  CL=9 One who rauses- who causes to rise up.
unnameti: [U+namu+ṇe+ti] (kā,kri) CL=7 He causes to rise up. He causes to bend upwards. He causes to be straight.
unnametvā: [U+namu+ṇe+tvā] (kri,vi) CL=7 Having caused to bend up.
unnamitvā: [U+namu+tvā] (kri,vi) CL=7 Having raised up. Having swollen up.
unnamābhāva: [Unnama+abhāva] (pu) CL=7 Lack of arrogance or being proud.
unnata: [U+nama+ta] (ti) CL=7 (1) Raised. Elevated. (2) Rises up or active. Arrogant. (3) Noble. (4) Agitate or wandering (of mind). See - Anunnata. (5) An ornament for a head. See - Uṇṇatuṇṇata, uṇṇatoṇata. Unnata(ti) [u+nama+ta] (1) Raised up or elevated. (2) One who is arrogant. (3) Inclines to upward. Agitates and wanders (of mind).
unnatabhāva: [Unnata+bhāva] (pu) CL=7 The state of being arrogant or rising up.
unnatadantī: [Unnatadanta+ī] (ti) CL=7 With a long teeth. One who has long eyeteeth. See - Unnadantī.
unnatakāya: [Unnata+kāya] (pu) CL=7 An upright body or an elevated body.
unnatakāyacitta: [Unnata+kāyacitta] (ti) CL=7 One whose mind and body incline upward or rise up.
unnataonata: [Unnata+onata] (ti) CL=7 One who is arrogant and down-hearted. (If one who faces good states such as sukha, is active or arrogant, if one faces to bad state such as Dukkha, is down-hearted).
unnatapadesa: [Unnata+padesa] (pu) CL=7 A high place or land.
unnatappadesa: [Unnata+padesa] (pu) CL=7 A high place or land.
unnatappāya: [Unnata+pāya] (ti) CL=7 Mostly raise up or elevate. See - Unnādī.
unnatapāya: [Unnata+pāya] (ti) CL=7 Mostly raise up or elevate. See - Unnādī.
unnataṅga: [Unnata+aṅga] (pu) CL=7 A high or tall body.
unnataṭṭhāna: [Unnata+ṭhāna] (na) CL=7 A high place or land.
unnati: [U+nama+ti] (thī) CL=7 Raising up. Being active or arrogant. Pride. See also - Uṇṇatilakkhaṇa.
unnatilakkhaṇa: [Uṇṇa(nna)ti+lakkhaṇa] (ti) CL=7 A sign of arrogance. (Pride). Unnatilakkhaṇa(ti) [unnati+lakkhaṇa]  (Pride) that has a sign of being active or arrogant.
unnatunnata: [Unnata+unnata] (ti) CL=7 High (in birth) and high (in moral behavior).
unnatunnataṭṭhāna: [Unnatunnata+ṭhāna] (na) CL=7 A high place or an elevated place.
unnatāvanata: [Unnata+avanata] (ti) CL=7 Raised and lowered. Some place is high and some place is lower.
unnatāvanati: [Unnata+avanati] (thī) CL=7 Raise and depress. Being arrogant and depressed.
unnaḷa: [U+naḷa] (ti) CL=7 One who is arrogant that is like a reed stalk. One who is proud that is useless.
unnaṅgala: [U+naṅgala] (ti) CL=7 A plow that stands (a place) which is stopped work. (Someone) stops plowing in the field for cultivation. Fishes the work of plowing.
unnāda: [U+nāda] (pu) CL=7 Loud resound or a loud echo (sound). See - Unnādī.
unnādana: [U+nada+ṇe+yu] (na) CL=7 Causes to be a loud sound. See - Unnādanattha.
unnādanattha: [Unnādana+attha] (pu) CL=7 The benefits of causing loud sound. The benefit of being noisy.
unnādasadda: [Unnāda+sadda] (pu) CL=7 The sound of shouting loudly.
unnādayamāna: [U+nada+ṇaya+māna] (ti) CL=7 Causes to be an echo (sound). (kri, vi) Causes noisy.
unnādayanta: [U+nada+ṇaya+anta] (ti) CL=7 Causes to be noisy. Causes to be an echo (sound). Make a sound that is like thunder (sound). Snoring or roaring. (kri, vi) Causing to be noisy. Causing to an echo (sound). Snoring or roaring.
unnādenta: [U+nada+ṇe+anta] (ti) CL=7 One who causes to be noisy. (kri, vi) Causing to be an echo sound.
unnādetvā: [U+nada+ṇe+tvā] (kri,vi) CL=7 Having shouted loudly. Having made resound.
unnādi: [U+nada+ī] (kri) CL=7 Shouted loudly. Made resound. See - Unnadati-(2).
unnādī: [(1)u+nada+ṇī.(2)unnāda+ī] (ti) CL=7 [In Thī unnādinī] One who is noisy. One who makes resound.
unnāma: [U+namu+ṇa] (pu) CL=7 (1) A high land. A high region. See - Unnāmaninnāma. (2) (Proud nature) that encourages (a person who is raising these proud).
unnāmaninnāma: [Unnāma+ninnāma] (pu) CL=7 A high place and a lower place. See - Unnāmaninnāmī.
unnāmaninnāmī: [Unnāma+ninnāma+ī] (ti) CL=7 The land that some places is high and in some places is low. Uneven land.
unnāmeti: [U+namu+ṇe+ti] (kri) CL=7 He causes to rise. He lifts up. He stretches.
unnāmetvā: [U+namu+ṇe+tvā] (kri,vi) CL=7 (A) Having caused to raise. Having caused to be high. (B) Having looked up.
